text:
marta: Quick postmortem follow-up — other teams saw TLS handshake error spikes on eu-west -> us-west path during yesterday's redeploy. Root postmortem here: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2188879999 (short version below).

alex: saw the same. Errors were mostly during session resume; retries spiked and we hit fallback to older pool. noticed increased TLS 1.2 fallback in logs. :eyes:

priya: can we list concrete remediation items + owners? want to avoid this becoming 'we'll fix it later'.

opsbot: Incident 2188879999 created: cross-region-tls-spike. Severity: P2. Notifying infra-oncall.

jamie: I started a quick triage: two recurring patterns — (1) SNI mismatch when ALB session-sticky to an older proxy; (2) some clients still sending older ciphers causing session resume to fail and force full handshake (timeout + retry).

alex: proposed action items:
- rotate proxy cert bundles to include new SAN order (owner: jamie)
- add SNI validation and stronger routing checks in edge (owner: marta)
- add metric + alert on session-resume fail-rate (owner: priya)
- schedule canary rollout for cert bundle (owner: jamie)

marta: assigning owners and tentative timelines:
- jamie: cert bundle rotation + canary by 2026-04-01
- priya: metric/alert by 2026-03-30 (dashboard + PagerDuty rule)
- marta: SNI routing rule change + rollout plan by 2026-04-05
- alex: post-deploy smoke test and rollback playbook by 2026-03-29
please ack if that's reasonable.

nikhil: what's the customer surface here? any active incidents to call out to CS?

marta: impact was transient — some API requests got 502s for a couple minutes, no data loss. CS already notified for top 5 customers. Good to keep them updated during the canary.

priya: adding runbook snippet for detecting session-resume failures:

```
# query new metric
sum(rate(tls_session_resume_failures_total[5m])) by (region)
```

and quick smoke test command: `curl --resolve api.redwood.example:443:54.23.12.7 https://api.redwood.example/health --tlsv1.3 -v` — check for "TLS session resumed" in handshake.

alex: pasted a representative log line from yesterday: `2026-03-18T22:14:02Z edge-proxy-12 ERR tls: handshake timeout, client=10.4.5.12, cipher=ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, session_id=0x0` — session_id 0x0 indicates resume failed and full handshake timed out.

jamie: will prepare cert bundle patch and a canary (10% of edge requests) — plan: rotate bundle on canary nodes -> monitor resume_fail and 5xx -> if green, expand to 100% over 2h. posting docs in #eng-infra.

opsbot: Deploy scheduled: cert-rotation-canary on 2026-03-29T18:00Z (CI: green).

marta: please add acceptance criteria to each action item:
- cert rotation: resume_fail_rate <= baseline + 0.1% after 30m at 10% traffic
- SNI routing rule: 0 route-misassign alerts for 24h post-rollout
- metrics: alert with severity >= P3 if resume_fail > 0.5% for 15m

alex: I'll own the smoke tests and rollback playbook: smoke steps + k8s rollback commands + quick lookout queries. Aiming for 2026-03-29 end of day.

priya: I'll wire alerts into the console dashboards and add a synthetic check from eu-west -> us-west to simulate cross-region.

nikhil: acked — will keep CS updated after canary starts, will escalate if customers report increased 5xx.

jamie: ack. I'll also add a short note in the cert rotation PR describing the SNI ordering rationale.

marta: thanks all. can we have a 15m sync next Monday 2026-03-30 09:30 UTC to review canary metrics? If so I'll put a calendar invite and add the runbook link.

alex: 👍

priya: 👍

jamie: +1

nikhil: will attend.

marta: I'll track these action items in the postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2188879999/actions — will update completion dates there. Closing this thread for now, reopen if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
